title: GDP (Geotechnical Data Package)
description:
GDP (Geotechnical Data Package) is a format for the factual data of a geotechnical investigation. People can read and write it by hand, with the tools they already use (a text editor or a spreadsheet), and software, AI assistants included, can validate it automatically and help generate it. A package is a folder of plain CSV tables, distributed as a zip file and described by a small TOML manifest and one file per investigation campaign.

Contents: the specification v0.1 in English with a Romanian translation, the machine-readable schema (normative), a reference validator with draft mode, a SQLite importer, two example packages and a test suite. Scope: soils only.
